description: List a playlist's items on a single page. Use market to relink tracks and flag unavailable ones, and fields/additional_types to trim the payload.

additional_types.description: Item types to include beyond the default 'track', e.g. ['track', 'episode']

fetch_all.description: Fetch every item across pages (up to 500), continuing FROM offset rather than restarting at 0. limit is the page size. Note: library tools' fetch_all instead ignores offset — contracts differ between modules (#110).

fields.description: Comma-separated list of response fields to keep, e.g. 'total,items(track(name,uri))'

market.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. 'GB'; relinks tracks to that market and flags unavailable ones

max_results.description: Max items to return (default: SPOTIFY_MCP_MAX_ITEMS env or 50)

response_format.description: 'concise' = human prose, 'detailed' = more fields in prose, 'json' = raw API object

name: get_playlist_items
